item.title: Education bill tracker: Indiana lawmakers advance bills on Indianapolis schools, cell phones, and more
item.description: New Indiana bills propose changes to cellphone policies, lessons on national identity, and laws covering youth gun possession.

item.title: A $10.5B school construction bond could help fix Newark’s old school buildings
item.description: A crossing guard helps students cross a busy street on Sept. 2, 2025 on the first day of school in Newark, New Jersey's East Ward neighborhood.

item.title: Michigan governor candidates talk ICE and ways to stop the state’s academic slide
item.description: Candidates for Michigan governor participate in an education forum hosted by the Michigan Education Association inside Detroit Marriott Renaissance Center on Friday, Feb. 6. The forum featured discussions on education issues in response to questions submitted by MEA members. From left: moderator Zoe Clark of Michigan Public and gubernatorial candidates Genesee County Sheriff Chris Swanson, Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson, former Attorney General Mike Cox, and former Detroit Mayor Mike Duggan.

item.title: Shortridge High School walkout caps week of anti-ICE protests: ‘Hard workers are not the criminals’
item.description: Shortridge High School students lined the sidewalk along Meridian Street to protest federal immigration enforcement efforts.

item.title: Plans to close Manhattan middle schools test Mamdani’s parent engagement pledge
item.description: Schools Chancellor Kamar Samuels set in motion a series of middle school closures and a relocation that are sparking fierce backlash. The proposals are an early test of Mayor Zohran Mamdani's commitment to hear families out.

item.title: NYC school board member faces outcry for using R-word in Bad Bunny Super Bowl post
item.description: Joe Borelli, pictured here in 2017, is facing calls to apologize after he used the R-word in reference to a lawmaker’s post about Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl performance.

item.title: State lawmakers introduce Chicago Teachers Union-backed bills to increase state education funding
item.description: Pre-K students at Johnson Elementary School in North Lawndale make trees using popsicle sticks and leaves as part of a STEAM lesson. A Chicago Teachers Union-backed pair of bills would boost state education funding.

item.title: Indiana tries again to restrict social media for minors: ‘It’s not the magic pill, but it will help’
item.description: Hailey Buzbee, a Fishers junior, in a photo provided by her dad, Beau Buzbee.

item.title: Philadelphia families at small schools like Parkway Northwest fight school closure plan
item.description: Parkway Northwest ninth grader Shakur Barron tells district officials at a community meeting on Feb. 4, 2026, that he is frustrated he may have to change schools midway through high school because of the district's school closure proposal.

item.title: Shelby County judge says 2026 school board reset election is unlawful
item.description: Only four MSCS board members will appear on the 2026 ballot, according to the judge's ruling.
